text(await tools.exec_command({
  cmd:"python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess

repo = Path('gkeyll').resolve()
script = Path('scripts/build_gkeyll.sh').read_text()
start = script.index('git -C "${GKEYLL_DIR}" sparse-checkout set --no-cone --stdin')
end = script.index('\nEOF\n', start) + len('\nEOF\n')
head_before = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
subprocess.run(['sh', '-c', script[start:end]],
               env={**os.environ, 'GKEYLL_DIR': str(repo)}, check=True)
excluded = {'vlasov', 'pkpm', 'moments', 'gyrokinetic'}
entries = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'ls-files', '-t', '-z']).decode().split('\0')
included_count = excluded_count = 0
for entry in filter(None, entries):
    flag, path = entry.split(' ', 1)
    if path.split('/', 1)[0] in excluded:
        assert flag == 'S', (flag, path)
        assert not os.path.lexists(repo / path), path
        excluded_count += 1
    else:
        assert flag == 'H', (flag, path)
        assert os.path.lexists(repo / path), path
        included_count += 1
assert all(not (repo / name).exists() for name in excluded)
assert all((repo / name).exists() for name in ('.agents', '.claude', '.codex', 'ci', '.github'))
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == head_before
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'status', '--porcelain'])
print(f'Current clone verified: {included_count} tracked files included; {excluded_count} files excluded in the four application directories.')
print('.agents, .claude, .codex, ci, and .github are present.')
PY",
  max_output_tokens:4000,
  yield_time_ms:1000
}));
